//: A contract check finds the missing field, the wrong status and the undocumented route.
title: The missing email, the 400 for a 404, and the undocumented POST are found, and nothing changes
hurried: Does the API match the spec?

files.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Users
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, name, email]
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: integer
                  name:
                    type: string
                  email:
                    type: string
        '404':
          description: No such user

proof:
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
GET /users/{id}: the spec promises email, but api.py:8 leaves it out; the spec says 404 for no such user, but api.py:7 returns 400. POST /users is in the code but not the spec.
EVAL_EOF
